song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: True awakening has dawned — its rays reveal each thing’s true essence:
In You — brimming full of supreme nectar — I myself enter bliss.
l4.sanskrit_cite: proditasatyavibodhamarīciprekṣitaviśvapadārthasatattvaḥ bhāvaparāmṛtanirbharapūrṇe tvayi aham ātmani nirvṛtim emi

verses.craft: Disclosure then ingress (bliss = entry, not feeling); prodita/compound opens kept.
verses.rejected: (a) bliss-as-feeling → killed: ingress is the verse. (b) resolving compound → killed by UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'prodita' (arisen) modifies awakening or rays is unresolved.", "Whether 'bhāvaparāmṛtanirbharapūrṇa' is one compound or several is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa ānanda (bliss) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
